3. Begin each entry by writing down the date and then write down three things that you are grateful for. These can be small or big things, as long as they bring a sense of gratitude.

4. Take a moment to reflect on each item and try to really feel grateful for that thing or person. You may want to elaborate on each one and write down why you are grateful for it.

5. Try to avoid repeating the same things every day. Instead, challenge yourself to think about different aspects of your life that you are grateful for.

6. As you cultivate mindfulness and gratitude, you may find that you naturally begin to focus more on the positive things in your life, even when you are not journaling.
